CustomField.description: Pipeline Health: Opportunity Close Health label derived from the Close Confidence Score. Reuse this as the health label in reports instead of building a new one.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.StageName, "Closed Won"), "🟢 Closed Won", IF( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.StageName, "Closed Lost"), "🔴 Closed Lost", IF( Close_Likelihood_Score__c >= 0.70, "🟢 Healthy", IF( Close_Likelihood_Score__c >= 0.45, "🟡 Needs Attention", "🔴 Off Track" ) ) & " (" & TEXT( ROUND( Close_Likelihood_Score__c * 100, 0 ) ) & "%)" ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Green, yellow or red health from the Close Confidence Score.
CustomField.label: Opportunity Close Health
